text: Completed 8 cycles of modified FOLFIRINOX with stable disease. Most recent CT shows continued stable disease with slight decrease in size of some liver metastases. CA 19-9: 320 U/mL (significant decrease from baseline 1250). Patient tolerating treatment reasonably well though cumulative toxicity present (grade 2 neuropathy, ongoing fatigue). Performance status ECOG 1. Given BRCA2 mutation and response to platinum-based therapy, transitioning to maintenance therapy with olaparib (PARP inhibitor) 300 mg twice daily. This approach supported by recent clinical trial data showing benefit in BRCA-mutated pancreatic cancer. Will continue olaparib until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Surveillance imaging every 8 weeks. Palliative care continues to follow for symptom management and advance care planning. Patient and family understand continued poor prognosis but encouraged by current disease control and quality of life maintenance.
